# Method IsUnmovableDocument

#### IsUnmovableDocument(DocumentId)

Determines whether the document is movable.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 19, 400, 180)]
bool IsUnmovableDocument(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyse.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  Tells wether the document is movable.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.19.
